shadows.usage: sparse; borders and paper tones first

patterns: desktop table to mobile card list

must: Start every screen at 360px and expand
Keep source and freshness within one action of every material value
Pair every semantic color with icon and text
Use the same component contract in ru, kk, and en with 30 percent expansion tolerance
Meet WCAG AA, 44px targets, visible focus, and prefers-reduced-motion
Keep light and dark semantic roles equivalent
avoid: admission probability, chance percentages, or traffic-light chance metaphors
lime, neon, gradients, 3D, glass effects, and crypto-game styling
coats of arms, shields, laurels, globes, literal doors, and literal books
more than three chips in one row
unknown values rendered as a dash or zero
claims of guaranteed admission or guaranteed funding

decisions.decision: Brandbook v1.1 supersedes v1.0; lime is removed everywhere.
decisions.reason: The v1.1 change log explicitly replaces the former Open Portal direction.

decisions.decision: Use Manrope for the wordmark, controls, and product chrome; use Fraunces only for editorial display moments.
decisions.reason: This preserves the brandbook's modern geometric voice and epics.md's proven serif editorial strength without turning dense UI into display typography.

decisions.decision: Keep exact brand colors as primitives, but use darker semantic text colors where an exact swatch fails 4.5:1 on Paper.
decisions.reason: Scholar Teal, Parchment Gold, and Deadline Coral are valid brand accents but not all are accessible as small text.

decisions.decision: Use the Open Page as a cropped corner and two-page negative-space motif, not a literal book illustration.
decisions.reason: The motif must express an opening and forward path at small sizes.

decisions.decision: Trust is structural: fact, assessment, and AI opinion have distinct forms, labels, and backgrounds.
decisions.reason: E16 requires users to classify origin without relying on color alone.
